description: For electrical call, this completion sign-off form records hazard screen, diagnostic boundary, outage plan, repair options, parts, permit needs, and price authorization. Its supporting evidence includes voltage or continuity readings, panel labels, thermal or condition photos, fault findings, and functional test.

subtitle: Electrical Call Completion Sign-Off Form: residential electrical service call dispatch using panel, hazard screen, and voltage or continuity readings.
title: Electrical Call Completion Sign-Off Form
use_case: Use the completion sign-off form during residential electrical service call dispatch when the electrical call record must identify panel, breaker, circuit, device, symptom, affected loads, occupancy, access, and prior modifications. Complete the applicable handoff for safe re-energization, label correction, customer explanation, permit status, repair warranty, and service record.
